sections.release_notes:
## :star: New Features

- Add RFC-8246 "immutable" attribute to `CacheControl` [#29955](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29955)
- Allow MockRest to match header/queryParam value list with one Matcher [#29953](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29953)
- DataBuffer should offer restricted access to underlying ByteBuffer [#29943](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29943)
- Introduce `HttpServiceProxyFactory#createClient` Kotlin extension [#29942](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29942)
- Support ProblemDetail serialization to XML with Jackson [#29927](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29927)
- Refine `TransactionalOperator.executeAndAwait` nullability [#29919](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29919)
- Early support for JDK 21 [#29910](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29910)
- StringDecoder causes direct allocation of ByteBuffer [#29889](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29889)
- Include all Hibernate query methods in `SharedEntityManagerCreator`'s `queryTerminatingMethods` set [#29886](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29886)
- Add native support for RSocketExchange. [#29877](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29877)
- Add `@Nullable` to `ProblemDetail.setProperty` value argument [#29868](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29868)
- Deprecate obsolete `ConcurrentExecutorAdapter` for removal in 6.1 [#29865](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29865)
- ContentDisposition.toString() should include both regular and extended filename parameter [#29861](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29861)
- Refine `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder#configureFeature` exception handling [#29859](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29859)
- Flexible constructor resolution in AutowireCapableBeanFactory.createBean(Class) [#29855](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29855)
- Optimize CorsConfiguration::checkHeaders [#29853](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29853)
- Spring Web RestTemplate `http.client.requests` Metrics No Longer Have `client.name` Tag [#29839](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29839)
- Allow `@Aspect` classes to extend concrete `@Aspect` classes [#29830](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29830)
- Custom Constraint Validator not work with native image [#29823](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29823)
- Deprecate HttpStatus 103 CHECKPOINT in favor of new EARLY\_HINTS [#29816](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29816)
- Fix R2dbcTransactionManager debug log: don't log a Mono [#29800](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29800)
- Improve generated default name for `@JmsListener` subscription [#29790](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29790)
- Support double-quoted values in HttpHeaders::getValuesAsList [#29785](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29785)
- Support method validation for an interface only proxy like an HTTP interface client [#29782](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29782)
- ResourceHandlers cannot resolve static resources without wildcard patterns [#29739](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29739)
- Release R2DBC connection when cleanup fails in transaction [#29703](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29703)
- Spring Webfilters and Kotlin Coroutines [#29672](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29672)
- Support "multipart/mixed" and "multipart/related" in DefaultServerWebExchange [#29671](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29671)
- `@JsonDeserialize(builder = ...)` does not work in GraalVM native image [#29646](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29646)
- Combined class and method `@RequestMapping` without patterns should match root path as both "" and "/"  [#29625](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29625)
- Prefer problem detail media type independent of ordering in Accept header [#29588](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29588)
- Restrict forwards in MockMvcWebConnection to 100 [#29557](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29557)
- `@JsonNaming` strategy is not supported in GraalVM native image [#29386](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29386)
- SQL supplier in R2DBC `DatabaseClient` is eagerly invoked [#29367](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29367)
- Set reason for WebSocket `CloseStatus.SESSION\_NOT\_RELIABLE` [#29220](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29220)
- HttpComponentsClientHttpConnector hangs when host is invalid [#29156](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29156)
- Add ResponseEntity.ofNullable() to deal with non-Optional nullable objects [#29117](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29117)
- Provide access to all configured interceptors in AbstractHandlerMapping [#28985](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28985)
- Support `Optional` in `PayloadMethodArgumentResolver` [#28945](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28945)
- Remove clear() call to release method of WeakEntryReference and SoftEntryReference [#28863](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28863)
- Add `MockMvc.multipart()` Kotlin extensions with `HttpMethod` [#28634](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28634)
- WebSocketConnectionManager constructor with prepared URI [#28524](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28524)
- Deprecate Base64Utils [#28434](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28434)
- List supported media types in HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException when given invalid input media types [#28062](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28062)
- Introduce getContentAsString and getContentAsByteArray to Resource [#24651](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24651)
- Support Optional in Jackson 2 message converters [#24498](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24498)
- Refine `ModelAttributeMethodProcessor` Kotlin exception handling [#23846](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23846)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- DefaultHandlerExceptionResolver::doResolveException no longer returns ModelAndView customized via protected method [#29971](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29971)
- `ex.getPropertyName()` is not initialized in `ResponseEntityExceptionHandler#handleTypeMismatch` [#29959](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29959)
- Violation of a unique index on insert in MSSQL is translated to DataIntegrityViolationException instead of DuplicateKeyException [#29950](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29950)
- PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver duplicates module/file resources [#29934](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29934)
- ResourceUrlEncodingFilter throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException in tests [#29933](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29933)
- Explicit target ClassLoader for interface-based proxies in MvcUriComponentsBuilder [#29913](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29913)
- org.springframework.web.context.ContextLoader cannot be loaded in a native image [#29905](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29905)
- MockHttpServletRequest InputStream has been made static in gh-29125 [#29901](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29901)
- MvcUriComponentsBuilder adds trailing slash if path is defined at controller level only [#29897](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29897)
- Closing an ApplicationContext leads to Exception at ExecutorServiceAdapter [#29892](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29892)
- Set WebClient Observation as current in reactor context [#29891](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29891)
- Client request observation contributes full URI template to uri meter tag values [#29885](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29885)
- HTTP client observations miss uri keyvalue for "/" requests [#29879](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29879)
- ProblemDetail is missing serialization hints for Native Image [#29801](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29801)
- Invalid Accept header results in IllegalStateException [#29794](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29794)
- AOT processing fails with Set if type doesn't implement Comparable [#29792](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29792)
- CSRF token not available to FreeMarker templates [#29787](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29787)
- Fail more explicitly when AOT attempts to handle a bean definition that uses an instance supplier [#29556](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29556)
- WebSocket stats not updated correctly when sessions cleared [#29375](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29375)
- `MockHttpServletRequest#setContentType` fails with `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException` [#29255](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29255)
- `InMemoryWebSessionStore#changeSessionId` makes blocking calls to UUID.randomUUID [#29212](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29212)
- ReactorServerHttpRequest does not reflect forwarded host and port when `forwarding-header-strategy=native` or cloud platform detected [#28601](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28601)
- Propagate `CoroutineContext` in reactive transaction [#27308](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27308)
- Bean validation doesn't work on Kotlin coroutines controller parameters [#23499](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23499)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Update `@DynamicPropertySource` examples regarding changes in Testcontainers [#29939](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29939)
- Refine `ControllerMappingReflectiveProcessor` documentation [#29938](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29938)
- Clarify semantics of `primitivesDefaultedForNullValue` in `BeanPropertyRowMapper` [#29923](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29923)
- Document instrumentation for RestTemplate and/or WebClient [#29904](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29904)
- CronExpression::parse has invalid Javadoc [#29884](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29884)
- Update Javadoc on async request timeout value in HandlerFunctionAdapter [#29882](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29882)
- Document how to mark an observation as an error if the exception was handled [#29848](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29848)
- Document that bean instance suppliers are not supported with AOT/native [#29835](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29835)
- Clearly document that `DataClassRowMapper` supports Java records [#29814](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29814)
- Increase number of TOC levels in generated PDF documentation [#29781](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29781)
- Consisten
